decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with vertical through contacts are a high-potential, technically uncertain option tied to EU research and wafer-level packaging trends, and keeping them on offer costs little because they extend existing drilling and bonding capabilities, so management keeps the option open while demand resolves.

The carrier wafer for smaller diameters builds directly on the firm's core thin-wafer handling business, needs almost no extra resources to keep, and fits its strategic direction toward reusable carriers, so there is no evidence yet that would justify abandoning it.
